title: Reviewer stance catalog
description: NEGATIVE CONTROL for wave 1wpie requirement 12. Hand-authored reference data with the repeated-key shape a naive size/shape heuristic would flag. It carries no provenance and no machine-run signature, so it must remain in its ordinary domain.

stances.prompt: Does the change do what it claims under adversarial inputs?
Is there a materially simpler design with the same guarantees?
What does a failure look like at 3am, and what does the operator do?
Is every claim backed by something a skeptic could re-derive?
What was quietly added or dropped relative to the stated request?
